    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersCovey kitchen kimchi pancakesCrisp kimchi and spring onion pancakes with a soy and sesame dipping sauceHow to make it300g vegetarian kimchi, chopped3 tbsp kimchi juice150g plain flour2 tbsp rice flour200ml cold water4 spring onions, cut in lengths3 tbsp vegetable oil3 tbsp soy sauce1 tbsp rice vinegar1 tsp toasted sesame seedsMix the flours, cold water, kimchi and kimchi juice into a thick batter, then stir in the spring onions.Heat half the oil in a large frying pan and spread in half the batter thinly.Fry 4 minutes until crisp underneath, flip and cook 3 minutes more. Repeat.Mix the soy sauce, vinegar and sesame seeds for dipping.Cut the pancakes into wedges and serve hot.Kitty's honey butter popcornLara Jean's little sister Kitty, who started it allHow to make itAs written, serves 4Freshly popped corn tossed in a sweet and salty Korean-style honey butter glaze, baked until crunchy and finished with flaky salt.Heat the oven to 150°C.Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a large covered pot over medium heat, shaking often, and tip into a big bowl.Melt 60g butter with 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp brown sugar and bubble for 1 minute.Pour over the popcorn, add half a tsp salt and toss well.Spread on lined trays and bake 10 minutes, stirring once.Cool, break up and sprinkle with flaky salt.MainsDr Covey's Korean marinated beefSoy, pear and garlic beef seared hot, jasmine rice, quick cucumber kimchiHow to make it600g beef rump4 tbsp soy sauce1 pear, grated3 cloves of garlic2 tbsp sesame oil300g jasmine rice, uncooked2 Lebanese cucumbers1 tsp salt1 tsp chilli flakes2 tbsp rice vinegarSlice the beef thin and marinate in soy, grated pear, crushed garlic and sesame oil for an hour.Cook the rice.Toss sliced cucumbers with salt, chilli and vinegar as a quick kimchi.Sear the beef hot in batches.Serve with the rice and cucumbers.Fake date diner cheeseburgersLara Jean and Peter's fake relationshipHow to make itAs written, serves 4Smashed beef patties with double cheddar, pickles, lettuce and a tangy burger sauce in toasted brioche buns, with crunchy shoestring fries.Roll 600g beef mince into 8 balls.Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for the sauce.Bake 750g frozen shoestring fries at 220°C for 20 minutes.Heat a heavy pan very hot, smash the balls flat and cook 2 minutes, flip, add a slice of cheddar to each and cook 1 minute.Toast 4 brioche buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties each with lettuce and pickles.SweetsHatbox love letter choc chip cookiesNutty brown butter cookies with dark and milk chocolate, flaky saltHow to make it170g butter150g brown sugar100g caster sugar1 egg1 egg yolk2 tsp vanilla extract250g plain flour1/2 tsp bicarb soda1/2 tsp salt100g dark chocolate, chopped100g milk chocolate, chopped1 tsp flaky saltMelt the butter in a saucepan and cook until nutty and golden brown.Cool.Whisk with the sugars, egg, yolk and vanilla. Stir in the flour, bicarb and salt, then the chocolate.Chill the dough, which is the resting time.Heat the oven to 180°C, roll into 16 balls and bake.Sprinkle with flaky salt and cool on the tray.Korean yoghurt drink ice blocksFrozen yoghurt and honey pops swirled with strawberry puréeHow to make it300g plain yoghurt200ml milk3 tbsp honey1 tbsp lemon juice150g strawberries1 tbsp caster sugar8 ice blocks of moulds and sticksBlend the yoghurt with the milk, honey and lemon juice until smooth and pourable.Blitz the strawberries with the sugar.Half fill the moulds with the yoghurt, add a spoonful of strawberry puree to each, then top up and swirl with a skewer.Insert sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours.Run the moulds under warm water to release.Peppermint choc dipped marshmallowsMarshmallows dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed peppermintHow to make it150g dark chocolate20 marshmallows50g peppermint lolliesMelt the chocolate.Dip the marshmallows halfway and roll the chocolate end in crushed peppermint lollies.Set on baking paper.DrinksKitty's strawberry milkMashed sugared strawberries stirred into cold milk over iceHow to make it300g strawberries4 tbsp caster sugar1 L full cream milk2 cups iceMash the strawberries with the sugar.Stand until juicy.Spoon into 4 glasses, add ice and top with cold milk. Stir before drinking.
